name: Market Research
description: State-tracking base for the market-research methodology. Three linked tables. Each Phase Output is linked to a Candidate; each Pain Signal is linked to a Candidate. Import via the Airtable MCP plugin's create_base / create_table / create_field tools, or set up manually following this schema as a guide.

tables.name: Candidates
tables.description: Products / categories / segments being evaluated. One row per candidate. Updated as candidates move through the 6-phase methodology.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Short candidate name (product, category, or segment). Primary field.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Where this candidate was surfaced (Acquire.com listing, Reddit thread, founder's own idea, etc.)

fields.name: Kill reason
fields.description: One-paragraph explanation of why this candidate was killed, if it was. Reference the specific failure (no angle, reachability, profitability, etc.)

tables.name: Phase Outputs
tables.description: Per-phase agent run verdicts. Linked to Candidates. One row per (candidate, phase) pair.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Short summary, e.g. 'AcmePOS - ICP Audit - kill'. Primary field.

fields.name: Evidence summary
fields.description: Short evidence summary. Full agent report belongs in 'Full output (link to file)'

fields.name: Full output (link to file)
fields.description: Path or URL to the agent's full written report

fields.name: Candidate
fields.description: Link to the Candidate this phase output belongs to

tables.name: Pain Signals
tables.description: Mined complaints / pain phrases / demand signals from research. Linked to Candidates.

fields.name: Pain phrase
fields.description: The pain quote or paraphrase, in the user's own words where possible. Primary field.

fields.name: Candidate
fields.description: Link to the Candidate this pain signal belongs to

installNotes: Two paths to set up this base in your Airtable account: (1) Use the Airtable MCP plugin's `create_base` tool with the `tables` array from this file, then `create_field` to add the `Candidate` multipleRecordLinks fields on Phase Outputs and Pain Signals (those linked fields cannot be created at base-creation time because the Candidates table ID doesn't exist yet). (2) Manually create the base in the Airtable UI following the schema above as a guide. After setup, save your base ID (format: `app[A-Za-z0-9]{14}`) in your plugin settings so subagents know where to write.
